scope: Khanda2 chapter1 verses51–55 and ending colophon
method: All three original Sanskrit crops were directly inspected and independently checked, with enlargement for dense readings. All five Sanskrit–Kannada pairs and the colophon received independent review. No PDFs, modern English or alternate editions used.
limitations: This verifies the five ending records and colophon, not the entire Purana or earlier Khanda1 material.
The parenthesized cumulative numeral below the colophon remains uncertain metadata; it is not a basis for inserting or removing verses.

verses.source_sanskrit:
ततो गणेशमन्त्रं च जजाप कमलासनः ।
पूजयित्वा यथान्यायं ध्यानसंस्थो बभूव ह ॥५१॥
verses.text: ಅನಂತರ ಕಮಲಾಸನನಾದ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನು ಗಣೇಶಮಂತ್ರವನ್ನು ಜಪಿಸಿದನು. ಯಥಾವಿಧಿಯಾಗಿ ಪೂಜಿಸಿ ಧ್ಯಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲೆಗೊಂಡನು. ॥೫೧॥
notes: Original Sanskrit crop inspected directly; no PDF or modern English used.
Confirmed from original pixels. कमलासनः identifies Brahma; यथान्यायम् is rendered ವಿಧಿವತ್ತಾಗಿ, and ध्यानसंस्थः as ಧ್ಯಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಿತನಾದನು. No uncertain substantive reading.

verses.source_sanskrit:
तस्य हृद्देशमध्येऽसौ प्रकटोऽभूद्गजाननः ।
तं ननाम स्वयं ब्रह्मा पूजां चक्रे स मानसीम् ॥५२॥
verses.text: ಅವನ ಹೃದಯದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಗಜಾನನನು ಪ್ರಕಟನಾದನು. ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನು ಸ್ವತಃ ಅವನಿಗೆ ನಮಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ ಮಾನಸಪೂಜೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದನು. ॥೫೨॥
notes: Original Sanskrit crop inspected directly; no PDF or modern English used.
Confirmed from original pixels and 3× enlargement. The printed sandhi is मध्येऽसौ; मानसीम् explicitly makes the worship mental. No uncertain substantive reading.

verses.source_sanskrit:
दक्षिणावसरे तत्र सिद्धिर्बुद्धिरुभे परे ।
आगते हृदि मध्ये च ते ददौ विघ्नहारिणे ॥५३॥
verses.text: ದಕ್ಷಿಣೆಯನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಪಿಸುವ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠರಾದ ಸಿದ್ಧಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬುದ್ಧಿ ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಅವನ ಹೃದಯದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಕಟರಾದರು. ಅವನು ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರನ್ನೂ ವಿಘ್ನಹಾರಿಗೆ ಸಮರ್ಪಿಸಿದನು. ॥೫೩॥
notes: Original Sanskrit crop inspected directly; no PDF or modern English used.

Confirmed independently from original pixels and 3× enlargement: दक्षिणावसरे, सिद्धिर्बुद्धिरुभे परे, and ते ददौ विघ्नहारिणे. Parse दक्षिणा + अवसरे as the occasion of offering dakshina, not a right-hand/left-hand location. परे is feminine dual agreeing with Siddhi and Buddhi and is rendered ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠರಾದ; ಪರಮಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠರಾದ is an allowable stronger alternative. The implicit giving subject is Brahma from verse 52. The verse says he offered the two to the remover of obstacles; it does not itself say marriage, daughters, wives, or wedding.

verses.source_sanskrit:
यथाशास्त्रविधानेन तस्य पूजां प्रगृह्य सः ।
अन्तर्धानं ययौ सद्यो गणेशः सर्वनायकः ॥५४॥
verses.text: ಸರ್ವನಾಯಕನಾದ ಗಣೇಶನು ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವಿಧಿಯಂತೆ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನು ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ ಪೂಜೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿ ಕೂಡಲೇ ಅಂತರ್ಧಾನನಾದನು. ॥೫೪॥
notes: Original Sanskrit crop inspected directly; no PDF or modern English used.
Brahma is named explicitly as the worshipper to avoid an ambiguous pronoun; Ganesh accepts the worship.
Confirmed from original pixels. प्रगृह्य is accepting/receiving worship; सद्यः is immediately. No uncertain substantive reading.

verses.source_sanskrit:
अन्तर्हिते गणेशाने हृदिस्थे ब्रह्मरूपिणि ।
तं प्रणम्य स्वयं ब्रह्मा सृष्टिं कर्तुं मनो दधे ॥५५॥
verses.text: ಹೃದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲೆಗೊಂಡಿದ್ದ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಸ್ವರೂಪಿಯಾದ ಗಣೇಶನು ಅಂತರ್ಧಾನನಾದಾಗ, ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನು ಸ್ವತಃ ಅವನಿಗೆ ನಮಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡಲು ಮನಸ್ಸು ಮಾಡಿದನು. ॥೫೫॥
notes: Original Sanskrit crop inspected directly; no PDF or modern English used.
ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಸ್ವರೂಪಿಯಾದ clarifies Brahman-form as a qualification of Ganesh; creation is intended, not yet completed.

Confirmed from original pixels and 3× enlargement. Locative absolute अन्तर्हिते गणेशाने governs the first clause; हृदिस्थे and ब्रह्मरूपिणि qualify Ganesha. मनो दधे expresses setting his mind on creation, not completion of creation. Verse 55 is immediately followed by the first-chapter colophon.

colophons.source_sanskrit:
॥ ओमिति श्रीमदन्त्ये पुराणोपनिषदि मौद्गले द्वितीयखण्डे
एकदन्तचरिते ब्रह्मसृष्टिप्रारम्भो नाम
प्रथमोऽध्यायः ॥
colophons.text: ಓಂ. ಹೀಗೆ ಶ್ರೀಮದಂತ್ಯ ಪುರಾಣೋಪನಿಷತ್ತಾದ ಮುದ್ಗಲ ಪುರಾಣದ ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ಖಂಡದ ಏಕದಂತಚರಿತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ “ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯ ಆರಂಭ” ಎಂಬ ಪ್ರಥಮ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯವು ಮುಗಿಯಿತು.
notes: Original pixels show ओमिति, correcting the initial draft ॐमिति.
The explicit colophon confirms chapter 1 ends after verse55 and names the beginning of Brahma’s creation; it does not signify the creation of Brahma.
The parenthesized cumulative numeral is excluded from the reading text because its exact transcription remains uncertain.
